claims.text: Cosmoserve Raises $6 Million to Remove Space Debris, Opens Hyderabad Facility
claims.llm_reason: The article states Cosmoserve raised $6 million and opened a facility in Hyderabad.

claims.text: The ex-ISRO founder's startup pairs a Rebright-led seed round with Base 1, a debris-removal test facility, and a retest of its failed first capture mission.
claims.llm_reason: The article mentions the seed round, Base 1 facility, and the retest of the capture mission.

claims.text: The $6 million seed round led by Japan's Rebright Partners takes Cosmoserve's total funding past $9 million since it was founded last year
claims.llm_reason: The article confirms the funding amount and total funding since founding.

claims.text: Base 1 in Hyderabad has a rendezvous and capture lab, an ISO Class 8 clean room and a microgravity simulation platform
claims.llm_reason: The article lists these specific facilities at Base 1.

claims.text: Founder Chiranjeevi Phanindra, who spent close to 15 years at ISRO, targets completing all technology demonstrations by 2027 and starting commercial operations by 2028
claims.llm_reason: The article states Phanindra's background and targets for technology demonstrations and operations.
